rv.q: In the meantime, see this No Exit, because it’s one of the most finely crafted you’ll ever see.
Wisely, I think, Scena Theatre has very appealingly treated No Exit with a satirical smirk and raised eyebrow — and with the actors playing their characters as if in air quotes.
Perfectly attired in Alisa Mandel’s brilliantly chosen costumes, the trio leads the audience through a deeply philosophical and emotional adventure, one in which anything can happen…and does.
Less familiar may be that hell, as brought to life by Scena Theatre and director Robert McNamara , is full of laughs.

cn.t: Scena Theatre brings surprising humor and freshness to Sartre's existential classic, with critics praising its droll, lighter touch on the famously bleak material and strong performances that make hell unexpectedly entertaining.
